content.name: Fast Hands
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check, use your {@item thieves' tools|srd51} to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the {@action Use an Object} action.

content.name: Fast Hands
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can do one of the following.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries: Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with {@item Thieves' Tools|SRD52} or to pick a pocket.

entries.name: Use an Object
entries: Take the {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, or take the {@action Magic|SRD52} action to use a magic item that requires that action.
